content:
Northeast India is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a romantic getaway to Northeast India, the experience is nothing short of transformative.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Northeast India
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Northeast India](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1692652567309-5ac9ae7fe6f7?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Hot air balloon rides over Northeast India provide a magical perspective that you will never forget.

## Where to Stay

Luxury resorts with private pools and ocean views create the ultimate romantic atmosphere in Northeast India.
